svg.text: The talk runs as one long chain from noticing what doesn't work to a closing wish, but widens twice into a
funnel-and-converge: first a survey of failed pseudosciences narrowing to one test for spotting them, later a set
of case studies that all converge on the same lesson about honesty.

g.text: A main chain runs top to bottom; it widens into three parallel failures that converge on a name, then narrows again
through the integrity principle to a final wish.

g.text: Case studies in poor science — detail
Four separate examples, each its own small chain, all arriving at the same point: skipping checks and controls is what
lets Cargo Cult Science pass as real science.
